scope: One isolated fresh macOS arm64 two-endpoint witnessed journal experiment. Product source unchanged by this experiment; not a managed-cutover implementation or cross-platform qualification.
observed: An actual two-endpoint handshake and accepted application ciphertext precede a complete quiescent original-journal snapshot.
The local fence alone refuses ordinary and anchored reopening while present.
Restoring the identical complete pre-fence database before witness retirement allows anchored reopening and releases the exact original cached ciphertext again.
Refencing with the independently retained original proposal does not require another operation or target.

After actual account-root witness retirement, restoring the same database cannot reopen a traffic journal. Direct server request returns AnchorError::Rejected(Error::Scope); the fixture carrier exposes AnchorClientError::Transport with io::ErrorKind::Other to the client.
The unavailable ordinary request is not a signed retirement receipt. Historical recovery separately authenticates and retains the exact purpose-22 receipt; no old traffic owner is returned.
development_failure: The first isolated test incorrectly expected the local-row Suspended error after the row had been restored away. Static tracing showed the witness rejection is mapped by the fixture carrier into a typed transport error. The corrected experiment checks both exact server rejection and exact client error; product behavior was unchanged. Original failed test patch, source identity and logs retained.
remaining: Parent account/enrollment authority and exact replacement intent must survive outside old journal backups and govern product reopen/import.
Whole-host rollback, witness rollback or witness-key compromise remain separate trust assumptions; this experiment restores only one fresh journal with its original key and retained witness.
Peer authority, stable application-account mapping, original target activation, historical delivery accounting and foreign adapters remain incomplete.
reproduce: Apply EXPERIMENT.patch to the recorded base_head in an isolated checkout and run the retained Cargo command with the selected toolchain/environment. No fixture data, private keys or journal backups are retained in this capsule.
